name: a2a-action
description: Hand one task to an external A2A agent when a trigger fires. Reaches only hosts the operator has allow-listed under Settings › Security › Network egress.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Agent URL
x-meta.help: The external agent's A2A tasks endpoint. The host must be listed in Settings › Security › Network egress — egress is deny-by-default, so an unlisted host is refused before any connection is made.

x-meta.label: Skill
x-meta.help: The skill id to invoke on the remote agent, as it appears on that agent's card. Leave blank to let the remote agent choose.

x-meta.label: Message
x-meta.help: The text sent to the agent. Supports $EVENT, $CONTEXT and any key from the trigger payload. Leave blank to send the event name and context.

x-meta.label: Inputs (JSON)
x-meta.help: Optional JSON object of structured inputs for the skill, e.g. {"since": "7d"}.

x-meta.label: Headers (JSON)
x-meta.help: Optional JSON object of extra request headers, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer …"} if the remote agent requires a bearer token.
